_note: Hand-written hints that win over tools/zh_hints.py rules, for frequent HSK 1 characters the rules leave awkward. At most 15; each states why the rule fails and the source it restates (MMAH = Make Me a Hanzi dictionary.txt at the pinned commit). Facts only, no invented etymology.

了.hint: a swaddled child, like 子 without its arms 一: done
了.reason: rule quotes a source typo (blanklets) and adds nothing to 子
了.source: MMAH 了 (child swaddled) and 子 (decomposition 了 + 一)

气.reason: MMAH names 亻 as a part, but 气 shows no person
气.source: MMAH 气 (breathing air); Wiktionary 气 glyph origin: pictogram of vapour

一.reason: source hint is a list of senses with Han characters in parentheses

电.hint: lightning 申 from 電 without its storm cloud 雨: electricity
电.reason: rule quotes the source's simplified-form note verbatim
电.source: MMAH 电 and 電 (thunderbolt 电 cast by a storm cloud 雨)

关.hint: simplified from 關, a gate 門: to close
关.reason: simplified parts 丷 + 天 carry no meaning

上.hint: a mark above the line 一 (opposite of 下): above, up
上.reason: HSK gloss's first alternative is 'first', and the source hint names no part
上.source: MMAH 上 (one stroke on top of another; compare 下)

生.hint: a shoot growing out of the soil 土: to grow, life
生.reason: rule shows 屮, which the simplified decomposition (一 + 土) does not contain
生.source: MMAH 生 (a shoot 屮 growing in the soil 土)

机.hint: a table 几 made of wood 木; 几 gives the sound: machine
机.reason: full source hint plus meaning runs over 14 words
机.source: MMAH 机 (a table 几 made of wood 木; 几 also provides the pronunciation)

时.hint: 日 (day) + 寸, simplified from 時 (sound 寺): time
时.reason: source names only the semantic side 日
时.source: MMAH 时 (semantic 日 day) and 時 (phonetic 寺)

不.hint: a bird flying toward the sky 一: not
不.reason: HSK gloss's first alternative 'no' reads as an answer, 'not' is the sense
不.source: MMAH 不 (a bird flying toward the sky 一)

来.hint: a wheat plant (from 來), borrowed for its sound: to come
来.reason: rule shows 未 not yet + 丷, misleading for 来
来.source: MMAH 來 (a wheat plant); Wiktionary 來 glyph origin: wheat, phonetic loan for 'come'

么.hint: simplified from 麼: 麻 (sound má) + 幺 (tiny): question particle
么.reason: simplified parts 丿 + 厶 carry no meaning
么.source: MMAH 麼 (phonetic 麻, semantic 幺) and 幺 (tiny, small)

中.hint: a line 丨 through the middle of a box 口: middle
中.reason: HSK 中 is not a single-character word, so the rule falls back to the source sense 'central'
中.source: MMAH 中 (a line 丨 through the center of a box 口)
